SELECT p.property_id AS propertyId,
pi.image_url AS thumbnailUrl,
p.property_type AS propertyType, p.transaction_type AS transactionType,
p.price AS price, p.deposit AS deposit, p.monthly_rent AS monthlyRent,
p.area_m2 AS areaM2, p.floor AS floor, p.maintenance_fee AS maintenanceFee,
CONCAT(r.province, ' ', r.city, ' ', r.district) AS regionName
FROM property p LEFT JOIN region r ON p.region_id = r.region_id
LEFT JOIN property_image pi ON p.property_id = pi.property_id AND pi.is_thumbnail = 1
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.property_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
